description: This file defines a React component called NoteEditor, which provides an interface for editing, saving, and deleting notes within a note-taking application. It handles local state management, optimistic updates, API interactions, and user interface elements related to note editing.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React functional component for editing a note with optimistic updates and auto-save.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the note data from the API if not initially provided.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events for the note's title and content fields, with debounce for auto-saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the updated note to the server with optimistic UI updates.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the note and redirects to the notes list.
